entries.text: FROZEN B1-9 §6 requires every declared action to appear in a non-empty, actor-invariant action_affordance map and requires GET affordance versus POST 403 agreement. The current ActionRegistry exposes no device-scoped action; the only device-adjacent action is DEVICE_REGISTER, which creates a device and is not a workspace action. Existing B1-9 evaluator explicitly records this gap. Please provide the authorized declared action IDs and owning activation route(s), or amend/defer AC-5/AC-6. Implementing an empty map or inventing an action would violate the frozen contract.

entries.text: PO decision: implement the actor-invariant action_affordance set using existing device-scoped registry actions and routes: device_inventory_collect (POST /devices/{id}/inventory/collect), device_configuration_collect (POST /devices/{id}/configuration/collect), and device_backup_collect (POST /devices/{id}/backup/collect).
